title: Sphacelate
summary: SPHAC'ELATE, verb intransitive [See Sphacelus.] 1. To mortify; to become gangrenous; as flesh. 2. To decay or become carious, as a bone. SPHAC'ELATE, verb transitive To affect with gangrene.
